name: Pokémon League Reception Gate & Badge Inspection
summary: Enter the majestic Reception Gate building connecting Route 22 to Route 23. League security officers verify all 8 Kanto Gym Badges in strict order, unlocking the pathway leading toward Victory Road.

items.name: Guard Spec
items.method: Gift from the League gatekeeper after confirming all 8 Badges

items.name: Max Ether
items.method: Hidden behind the ornate pillar near the Earth Badge checkpoint
